active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: 681a shows that missing local EWMA drift information is not the main bottleneck. Adding drift as a feature, even without deterministic centering, worsens IV level-law and free-running path allocation. The active bottleneck is conditional allocation under generated paths: the law must use the correct history more strongly without adding more normalization/readout knobs.
last_result_summary: 681a added scale_drift prefix features and drift_feature_mode=ewma_mean while keeping zero reconstruction center. IV-only fell to 4/11: coverage90 0.794, calibration error 0.068, IV level KS 8/25, median-bias magnitude 21/25, mean-reversion ratio 1.369, and pathwise max-jump KS 0.691. Joint38 also reached 4/11: coverage90 0.771, conditional MAE reduction 5.7%, kurtosis ratio 0.659, IV level KS 5/25, median-bias fraction 9/25, mean-reversion ratio 1.341, and pathwise max-jump KS 0.684. Joint panel stayed partially acceptable with factor delta KS mean 0.125, 10/13 factor KS pass, all q99 factor tails pass, factor-factor corr 0.831, and IV-factor corr 0.909.
next_step_recommendation: Close the EWMA drift branch. Return to the zero-center incumbent and implement a rollout-level conditional contrast/proper-score objective: generated paths under the correct history should score better against the realized future than paths sampled from shuffled histories. Start from the 674a/675a IV incumbent and the 676a/677a joint incumbent rather than adding new preprocessing.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. Within the clean general IV/anchor/joint state-aware normalized-innovation family, 666a remains the best joint-audited checkpoint, while 674a/675a is the strongest recent IV-only candidate at 7/11 with high-sample evaluation: coverage90 0.845, level KS passed, mean reversion passed, and pathwise realism passed. A joint38 audit is required before promoting the 674a-style training recipe as the general baseline.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
